thread:
emma (sec-eng): Heads up - triage call needed. New CVE chain affecting cert-manager (CVE-2026-0432), kubelet privilege escalation (CVE-2026-0510) and an etcd auth bypass (CVE-2026-0487). Initial severity: cert-manager (7.8), kubelet (8.6), etcd (9.1). We need an upgrade + mitigation playbook ASAP.

raj (infra): Ack. Are there vendor patches available for all three? any operator compatibility notes?

sophia (platform): cert-manager upstream has a 1.11.3 patch that addresses the cert issuance path. In our clusters we run cert-manager v1.10.x via the operator; need to test CRD/grafana-cert hooks.

li (sre): kubelet fix is in kube 1.27.4+; some of our older GKE nodes are on 1.26.5. We should schedule a node OS + kubelet upgrade. Also flagging rollback steps in case CNI or drivers break.

mike (eng-ml): etcd auth bypass patch is out for 3.5.11, but restores need verification. Any plan for snapshot/restore validation before rolling?

emma (sec-eng): Proposed immediate mitigations: 1) WAF/ingress rule to block non-whitelisted admin paths to cert-manager. 2) Temporarily tighten RBAC for cert-manager controller role to remove wildcard verbs for secrets. 3) Force KMS-encrypted etcd snapshots and rotate keys after patch.

raj (infra): For KMS, we need to confirm our etcd operator can use the KMS provider plugin for on-disk key encryption + snapshot encryption. @sophia can you confirm KMS IAM changes we need?

sophia (platform): We need two things: key version rotation policy + a service account that only the etcd operator can use. IAM policy snippet: 

```
roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter: allow
resource: projects/REDACTED/locations/global/keyRings/etcd-keys/cryptoKeys/etcd-main
```

Also will add a path in our terraform module to bind the SA.

li (sre): Quick checklist for rolling: canary namespace (5% control plane nodes) -> run etcd snapshot + restore test -> upgrade cert-manager operator -> upgrade kubelet nodes -> promote. Need exact commands for automation.

emma (sec-eng): Adding sample commands for the snapshot flow: 

```
etcdctl --endpoints=https://10.0.1.5:2379 --cert=/etc/etcd/peer.crt --key=/etc/etcd/peer.key snapshot save /tmp/etcd-snap-$(date +%s).db
ETCDCTL_API=3 etcdctl snapshot status /tmp/etcd-snap-*.db
# restore into test cluster
etcdctl snapshot restore /tmp/etcd-snap-*.db --data-dir=/var/lib/etcd-restored
```

raj (infra): Good. For RBAC change, let's propose a minimal policy diff and deploy as a canary in dev first. Example patch: 

```
# old
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRole
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["secrets"]
  verbs: ["*"]
# new - restrict
verbs: ["get","list","watch","create"]
```

mike (eng-ml): Will run cert issuance/eval jobs against 1.11.3 in staging. Note: some inference infra uses cert-manager annotated issuers for ephemeral certs; we should test TTLs.

emma (sec-eng): Audit logging changes: enable more granular auditPolicy for cert-manager namespace to capture requestBody for create/update of secrets for 72 hours. Example snippet to add to audit policy: 

```
- level: RequestResponse
  resources:
  - group: ""
    resources: ["secrets"]
  namespaces: ["cert-manager"]
  userGroups: ["system:serviceaccounts:cert-manager"]
```

But we must watch log egress costs. li, can you estimate?

li (sre): Estimated extra storage ~3GB/day for clusters with heavy cert churn. We can short-retain to 72h and snapshot to cold storage weekly. I'll add Grafana dashboard for audit log rate.

sophia (platform): Operator compatibility: bumping cert-manager to 1.11.3 requires controller args change: --enable-legacy-issuer=false toggles some behavior. We'll add this to the chart values and keep a canary namespace.

emma (sec-eng): Prioritization notes: etcd fix HIGH (9.1) -> immediate patching on control plane, with snapshot+restore tested before. Kubelet privilege ESC MED-HIGH -> schedule node upgrade windows, prefer drain+upgrade for low-traffic pools. cert-manager mod HIGH -> operator upgrade + RBAC tightening as emergency canary.

raj (infra): Timeline proposal: Today - apply RBAC tightening in dev/stage. T+24h - run snapshot restore test in staging. T+48-72h - etcd control plane patch in canary masters. Next maintenance window - kubelet node upgrades.

mike (eng-ml): If anyone breaks ephemeral certs, ping me; I can temporarily override TTLs in our test harness.

audit-bot: new alert: cluster-prod-audit-rate spike detected at 1772349038 - increased secret create events in cert-manager namespace :rotating_light:

emma (sec-eng): Noted. Action items: 1) li: estimate audit logs cost + dashboard (owner). 2) sophia: prepare terraform KMS changes + SA (owner). 3) raj: prepare canary automation + snapshot playbook (owner). 4) mike: run cert-manager integration tests (owner). 5) emma: draft comms for SRE/Platform teams and schedule triage call.

li (sre): On it. I'll post the snapshot job and restore runbook in #eng-oncall once done.

raj (infra): I'll spin up a 3-node restore cluster in staging and run the etcd restore script later today.

sophia (platform): Terraform PR incoming with KMS SA binding, will mark WIP.

emma (sec-eng): Thanks all. If we see evidence of active exploitation we escalate to incident channel. For now treat as urgent vuln triage. :thumbsup:
